chunks: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said that [statement]
when the religion was few in number
but now that its expanse has widened and it is firmly settled
everyone is free in his action.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'itssawa nitaquhu' in the context of Islamic history?
ai.summary: This narration highlights the principle of *al-hukm yaduru ma'a al-'illah* (the ruling follows the cause) by contrasting the early Meccan period, when Islam was a minority faith and distinctiveness was crucial, with the Medinan period of expansion. It illustrates how the Prophet (S) relaxed certain strictures, such as prohibitions on dyeing hair to avoid imitation of non-Muslims, once the Muslim identity was firmly established and widespread. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of the dynamic nature of religious law in response to changing social and political contexts.
